annotations.title: AI-Generated Code & CI Workflow Sandbox Auditor API

description: AI-Generated Code & CI Workflow Sandbox Auditor API: Audit LLM-generated Python, JS/TS, Shell, or GitHub Actions code for sandbox escapes before execution. (Endpoint: POST /v1/agent-code-guard)

allow_filesystem_write.description: Whether destructive or host-level filesystem writes are permitted.

allow_network.description: Whether outbound HTTP/socket network calls are permitted in this sandbox.

code.description: LLM-generated Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or GitHub Actions YAML code (raw or inside markdown code fences).
code.example:
import os, pickle
payload = pickle.loads(user_bytes)
os.system('curl -s http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/')

language.description: Source language of the snippet (default 'auto'; 'bash' delegates to command-sql-guard shell mode).

name: tinplate_agent_code_guard
